reason: Checked against the source. walk_column is reached only through plot_mover (plot_mover_sprite at game.6502:1977), and steps_known is reached only from inside walk_column. It is not PROTECTED (grind_config PROTECT and PROTECT_BYTES), not generated, not data and not raster-timed. It runs with bank 4 paged and only reads and writes the same zero page as before. C after the third ASL is bit 5 of steps, so steps must not have bit 5 set. Unwrapped n: steps <= n <= 13, because every sprite animation_table holds (I checked all of its values, which include &33-&4B; the candidate's list was incomplete) and every mover_types_third_sprite entry (09,0C,0E,20) has a column count <= &0C. The two odd counts, &32 (&82) and &36 (&00), appear in neither table. Wrapped n (clipped >= count): this happens only after the left clip, which sets mover_x_low = edge_x_low = viewport_left_low. Then d = viewport_right_low - viewport_left_low = &4F always: reset sets &FFFF/&FFB0, the scrolls, prebuild and buffer_to_view move both together. n-1 >= ~225 > d, so the code takes walk_beyond_steps with steps = 80 = %1010000 (bit 5 clear, C = 0), or walked (flipped, n-1 = 255). So the ADC always runs with C = 0 and its result is unchanged. SKIP 1 after the RTS is never executed or read, so the shipping and bench addresses stay as they were. In GAMEPLAY_ANY builds the pad is dropped the same way decision 43's other padding is. Room: 0 bytes in the shipping build, -1 in gameplay builds.
